generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with edit-target.png first and L2-seed-region-r2-source.png second as reference only

lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean after a local separable Lanczos3 reproduction at the 2560 px shipped canvas; water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: The aggregate orientation proxy is near-balanced, but many boulders retain visibly brighter upper facets and darker lower or side facets. The hard no-lit-side rule is not established.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Manual median of fourteen complete discernible crowns across the inland clusters and isolated right-side trees, using 10-source-pixel diagnostic grids; frame-clipped crowns were excluded. The automated dark-green component proxy fragmented overlapping crowns and was not used as the reported width.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: Broad gently sloping moor and inland ground count as buildable; only the immediate low shore bank and the beck hollow count as steep; shingle, exposed rock, boulders, scrub, and conifer clusters make up the remainder.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Source-raster colour, luminance, wet-margin, and dark-channel classification constrained by broad coast and inland-hydrology search envelopes, followed by source-pixel connectivity, scanline filling beneath visibly submerged shore rock, raster closure, and enclosed-hole filling. No hand-authored polyline supplies the boundary.

final_canvas_gate_reproduction.resize: local separable Lanczos3 reproduction matching the repository measurement implementation
final_canvas_gate_reproduction.note: The installed Node executable exists at C:/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe but the managed sandbox returns Access is denied. The repository's Lanczos3 and fringe formulas were reproduced locally with System.Drawing.

open_risks: Hard edge topology failure: the generated sound paints 165 north-edge pixels and no south-edge pixels; it therefore reaches the north edge despite the dry requirement and stops short of the required south-west corner. The water mask follows the painted source and does not conceal this defect.
Hard scale failure: the measured median conifer crown is about 65.327 px / 3.136 m at final scale, below the required 84-147 px / 4-7 m range; several isolated crowns are visibly smaller still.
Hard lighting failure: several boulders show brighter upper facets and darker lower or side facets despite the low aggregate directional asymmetry proxy.

Hard rock-language risk: much of the coast and inland ground is rendered as dense small faceted stones, while preserved neighbour paint includes geometric block-like rocks; the full source does not read as predominantly smooth rounded face-free basalt.
Biome transition risk: gold-green moor remains dominant across most dry land instead of resolving clearly into austere grey rock, pale sand, and thin olive grass past the transition bands.
The source cannot be corrected without violating the one-edit-call limit. It remains quarantine-only for director and owner review; this report does not claim visual acceptance.
